description: Ministry of Defence - Amendment to the Charging Fees of the Private Security Agencies that published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1105/27 of 12.11.1999
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the Regulation of Private Security Agencies Act, No. 45 of 1998, which involves amendments to fee structures and regulatory requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
